remarks: Stylish and move-in ready one-bedroom townhouse featuring hardwood floors throughout and a bright eat-in kitchen with breakfast bar seating. The upper level offers a nice size bedroom, with ceiling fan, spa-like full shower, and in-unit washer/dryer. Abundant natural light, ample storage, and refined finishes create a comfortable, easy-to-maintain living space. Perfectly situated within walking distance to the beach, shops, and local amenities. Owner lives next door unit #1. (1) vehicle parking space allocated private driveway. On street parking for guests. This unit is 650 sq. ft.
